description: Totals for the signed-in person: item count, combined value, number of collections, and how many items are lent out. The item count and the value cover the items the person owns, including items lent out. Wishlist, borrowed and archived items and gifts are left out, and so is an item marked as borrowed from someone. Value is the display_value of each item (the current value when set, otherwise the estimate when there is one) multiplied by quantity. An item with neither adds 0. The price paid is never used as a value. The number is unformatted.
name: get_inventory_summary
title: Inventory summary
